items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: Reg Marshall booked me quite a bit. ... He got me some pretty nice spots

ctx.x: Marshal Royal, Reg Marshall booked you for a while; didn't he?

Oh, yes, Reg Marshall booked me quite a bit. I'm glad you thought of that, because I forgot about him. He got me some pretty nice spots, I mentioned I think, about Schoonover, that carried me west, but like sandlot and big league, Reg--
So Reg liked the sandlot to the big league?
